text:
ara: Heads-up — kickoff with FinCraft POC today. They want streaming SDK + function/tool calling and structured JSON outputs. Main blockers flagged: on-prem data residency, KMS integration, token rotation for long-lived streams, and pricing for sustained 200 QPS.
jordan: Got it. Do they need VPC/private deployment or just EU-only hosted?
ara: CFO asked for on-prem or VPC first pass. Security team will run questionnaire. They also want audit logs retained 1 year.
sophie: For streaming + function calls: our SDK supports SSE and websocket. For structured output we recommend the tool-calling JSON schema. I can paste an example soon.
ricardo: Pricing question — 200 QPS sustained with streaming and tool calls is unusual. Are they expecting lots of token-level output? avg tokens per response?
ara: Estimate ~150 tokens/resp. Some requests will trigger 2 tool calls.
ricardo: Ok rough math: 200 QPS * 150 tokens = 30k tokens/s -> scaled monthly is massive. We should propose Dedicated reserved capacity or commit discount. I'll draft an options table.
jordan: Also they asked about ephemeral credential rotation for browser clients. We should confirm TLS termination in VPC and short-lived creds for SDK.
sophie: Example client handshake (websocket):
```
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.example/stream?model=redwood-rt');
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'init', token: TEMP_TOKEN}))); 
ws.on('message', (m) => handleChunk(JSON.parse(m)));
```
For function/tool calls we return a structured call object: {"tool":"search","args":{}} and SDK will invoke tool adapter.
ricardo: For security questionnaire: we need to confirm SOC2 + KMS options (customer-managed keys), SIEM export (syslog), and retention SLA. I'll assign legal to review.
ara: Action items: @sophie — prepare minimal sample app for streaming+toolcall (JS + Go examples) by EOD. @ricardo — pricing options (hosted vs dedicated vs private) + monthly cost estimates. @jordan — runbook for ephemeral creds + token rotation flow. I'll coordinate with FinCraft CISO for questionnaire.
sophie: Will do. Quick note: structured output and strict schema reduces token churn. We should highlight batching + prefix caching in the deck.
opsbot: Reminder: created ticket POC-923 in presales tracker for FinCraft (assigned: sales).
ricardo: I'll include reserved capacity vs burst pricing table. Also need to call out fallback policies — can we route to smaller quantized model if capacity strained?
sophie: Yes — runtime supports model fallback. Add the regression risk note (small differences in outputs).
jordan: On rotation: suggest STS-style ephemeral tokens 5m TTL for browser, SDK manages refresh. Show sample exchange in runbook.
ara: FinCraft kickoff call scheduled 16:00 UTC. I'll invite sec + eng runtime + pricing. Please bring one slide each.
sophie: Adding small sample of structured output enforcement: we can validate outputs server-side and reject malformed tool calls to avoid bad downstream effects.
ricardo: FYI I'll include an optional add-on: 1 year audit log retention (s3 export) and a monthly audit retrieval SLA for enterprise. Pricing as opt-in.
ara: Perfect. If anyone needs access to FinCraft SSO questionnaire, ping me, I'll share the doc. :thumbsup:
ricardo: Pinged — thanks.
ara: Thanks team. Short thread — see you on the call.
